features: connected-grid waypoint execution for boundary tests
limitations: ROS 2 Jazzy runtime was not available in the artifact-generation container, so live topic and hardware execution must be tested on the Raspberry Pi.
Physical position, backlash, temperature, and grasp-center measurements require operator input because the current hobby servos provide no joint feedback.
Raw pulse calibration bypasses the IK validator and must only be enabled under direct supervision.
